acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL define the canonical compound identity line in exactly one `_data` field consumed verbatim by the homepage hero, the About page, and the meta description
acceptance_checks.verify_method: grep finds the identity string defined once under `_data/`; index.html, about.html, `_includes/head/meta.html` each reference that field

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL present one canonical job title identically in `_data/character_build.yml` and `_data/jobs.yaml`, replacing the Director-of-Development vs Director-of-Engineering split
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the job title in character_build.yml equals jobs.yaml[0].title; `grep -rn "Director of" _data` yields a single distinct title

acceptance_checks.then: the repository SHALL document the five themed post-types as the closed set of allowed `type` front-matter values in a committed conventions file
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a conventions doc enumerates {scroll, cantrip, log, distillation, transmutation} as the permitted `type:` values

acceptance_checks.when: `jekyll build` runs with `JEKYLL_ENV=production`
acceptance_checks.then: the build SHALL exit 0 with no missing-layout or missing-include error in its log
acceptance_checks.verify_method: gate: `jekyll build` exits 0; build log contains no "Could not find layout" or "Included file not found"

acceptance_checks.given: favicon and social-card image references in the built output
acceptance_checks.when: `_site` is scanned for local image paths
acceptance_checks.then: every referenced local image SHALL resolve to a file that exists, never a dangling path such as bottle.png or me.jpg
acceptance_checks.verify_method: script asserts each local image reference in `_site` exists on disk; zero missing

acceptance_checks.given: a post carrying a per-post summary field
acceptance_checks.when: the page is built with jekyll-seo-tag enabled
acceptance_checks.then: the emitted meta description SHALL be that post's own summary rather than the generic site description
acceptance_checks.verify_method: for a sample post, the `_site` meta description equals the post summary text, not `site.description`

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a syndication feed whose entries contain the full post body rather than a truncated excerpt
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the first `feed.xml` entry content length is within 5% of the rendered post body length

acceptance_checks.then: the site chrome SHALL surface a human-visible link to the feed in the header or footer, not only a `<link rel>` hint
acceptance_checks.verify_method: an `<a>` whose href resolves to the feed appears in the rendered header or footer markup

acceptance_checks.when: the built site is scanned for analytics identifiers
acceptance_checks.then: no `UA-` Universal Analytics identifier SHALL remain in any emitted page
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -r "UA-135917274" _site` returns zero matches

acceptance_checks.then: the build SHALL emit a `sitemap.xml` listing the published pages of the site
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/sitemap.xml` exists and lists at least the home, About, Notebook, plus each post URL

acceptance_checks.then: every rendered page SHALL carry a canonical URL whose host is the served `hlavezzo.me` origin
acceptance_checks.verify_method: each page's `<link rel="canonical">` host equals `hlavezzo.me`

acceptance_checks.when: it is rendered
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL surface reader-facing post content below the hero rather than a hero-only landing
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/index.html` contains a post-list region linking at least the most recent post permalink

acceptance_checks.when: a reader filters by any category present in the post corpus
acceptance_checks.then: every post SHALL be reachable through a non-"All" tab, never orphaned behind a phantom `storybook` tab
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the set of tab `data-category` values equals the set of categories used by posts; no tab maps to zero posts

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a `/now` page that displays a visible last-updated date
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/now/` renders and contains a "last updated" date string

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a `/uses` page listing the current toolchain including the AI familiars
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/uses/` renders and lists hardware or editor plus the AI tools such as Claude or local models

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL serve a 404 page rendered through an existing themed layout rather than the unstyled minima remnant
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/404.html` renders with the site chrome; no reference to a missing `page` layout remains

acceptance_checks.given: a post declaring a `type` from the themed vocabulary
acceptance_checks.when: the post renders
acceptance_checks.then: the post layout SHALL display a visible post-type badge matching that declared type
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a post with `type: cantrip` renders a badge labeled for the cantrip type in `_site`

acceptance_checks.given: a post that sets the optional epistemic-status (`assay`) field
acceptance_checks.when: the post renders
acceptance_checks.then: the layout SHALL display the declared epistemic-status label
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a post with `assay: speculative` renders the speculative label in `_site`

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish a reader-contract page stating the right-to-be-wrong or living-document terms for the journal
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a terms or contract page renders and states the correction or revision policy

acceptance_checks.then: every page SHALL carry a sitewide "opinions are my own, not my employer's" disclaimer in the global footer
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the disclaimer string appears in the shared footer include of every rendered page

acceptance_checks.when: the research-dump ("transmutation") post-type is applied to it
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL render with a post-type badge visibly distinct from the handcrafted "scroll" essays
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the post's rendered badge label differs from a scroll post's badge label

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL provide a cadence-anchor stream ("Alchemist's Log") with its own index or tag aggregation page
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a log index or tag page renders and lists the log-type entries

acceptance_checks.given: a post whose body contains headings
acceptance_checks.when: the rendered page is loaded with JavaScript disabled
acceptance_checks.then: the table-of-contents region SHALL contain server-rendered links to those headings rather than an empty "Contents" shell
acceptance_checks.verify_method: JS-disabled fetch of a post shows `#toc-content` containing at least one anchor whose href matches a heading id

acceptance_checks.when: the operating system reports a reduced-motion preference
acceptance_checks.then: no script-created animated node SHALL be injected into the page DOM
acceptance_checks.verify_method: headless run with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulated over Home, About, Notebook, Laboratory, and Letter asserts zero script-injected animated nodes; `grep -rn "style.animation" assets/js/` shows every injection site behind a `matchMedia` reduced-motion guard

acceptance_checks.given: a visitor whose operating system reports a dark colour-scheme preference
acceptance_checks.when: any page is loaded with JavaScript disabled
acceptance_checks.then: the page SHALL render in the dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: JS-disabled render with `prefers-color-scheme: dark` emulated shows the dark theme background token on every page, not only post pages

acceptance_checks.then: every palette token whose manifest role is `content` SHALL reach a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against each declared background it is used on
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the palette contrast unit test enumerates every (token, background) pair in which a `content`-role token is used across the declared-background set -- cream, light, parchment-dark, and the hero gradient stops `#211C30`/`#312A45` -- and asserts every pair is >= 4.5 without rounding; the test fails if the `content` set is empty

acceptance_checks.then: every meaning-bearing non-text boundary SHALL reach a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against its adjacent colour
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the palette contrast test asserts the stat-bar track hairline and fill-edge tokens are >= 3:1 against the adjacent surface without rounding

acceptance_checks.then: each character-sheet HP, MP, and ST bar SHALL expose `role="meter"` carrying `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuetext`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe run on the About page reports each HP/MP/ST bar with role meter and a non-empty aria-valuetext such as "85 of 100 hit points"

acceptance_checks.then: the EXP bar SHALL expose `role="progressbar"` rather than `role="meter"`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe run on the About page reports the EXP bar with role progressbar and the required aria-value attributes

acceptance_checks.given: a project rendered with a rarity tier
acceptance_checks.when: the rarity chip is presented
acceptance_checks.then: the tier SHALL be conveyed by a visible text label, never by chip colour alone
acceptance_checks.verify_method: each rarity chip in `_site` contains the tier word as text; Color Oracle simulation confirms tiers remain distinguishable without hue

acceptance_checks.given: any auto-starting animation presented in parallel with other content on any page
acceptance_checks.when: the page is loaded with no motion preference expressed
acceptance_checks.then: the animation SHALL complete within five seconds rather than loop indefinitely
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rn "infinite" _sass/ assets/js/` returns zero hits outside a `--motionOK` gated block; each remaining animation declares a finite duration <= 5s and a non-infinite iteration count

acceptance_checks.then: every purely decorative SVG ornament SHALL be hidden from assistive technology by exactly one method
acceptance_checks.verify_method: each ornament SVG root carries `aria-hidden="true"` and no ornament carries both `aria-hidden` and an empty `alt`

acceptance_checks.then: every themed navigation item SHALL expose an accessible name that contains its visible themed label
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the accessible name for the Notebook link contains the string "Notebook"; axe reports no label-in-name violation

acceptance_checks.given: a fluid type rule expressed with `clamp()`
acceptance_checks.when: the rule is evaluated
acceptance_checks.then: its maximum value SHALL be no more than 2.5 times its minimum value
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script parses every `clamp()` in `_sass/` and asserts max/min <= 2.5

acceptance_checks.when: it is viewed at a viewport width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels
acceptance_checks.then: the content SHALL reflow without requiring scrolling in two dimensions
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a 320px-wide render of Home, About, and one post shows no horizontal scrollbar

acceptance_checks.when: it receives keyboard focus
acceptance_checks.then: its focus indicator SHALL remain visible and not be entirely obscured by the fixed sidebar or sticky chrome
acceptance_checks.verify_method: keyboard walk of Home, About, and one post shows a visible focus ring on every interactive element with no element hidden behind the 60px sidebar

acceptance_checks.then: every pointer target SHALL present a hit area of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or satisfy the 24px spacing exception
acceptance_checks.verify_method: axe target-size check reports zero violations across the sigil nav and social icon row

acceptance_checks.given: a themed chip, badge, banner, or stat row
acceptance_checks.when: a user overrides text spacing to the 1.4.12 values
acceptance_checks.then: no text SHALL be clipped by a fixed height
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rnE '(^|[^-[:alnum:]])height:[[:space:]]*[0-9]' _sass/` returns zero hits within themed chip, badge, banner, or stat-row rule blocks (this pattern excludes `min-height`/`max-height`/`line-height`); the text-spacing bookmarklet clips nothing

acceptance_checks.then: the continuous-integration pipeline SHALL fail the build when any sitemap URL reports a WCAG 2.2 AA violation
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `pa11y-ci` with the axe runner and `standard: WCAG2AA` runs over the sitemap in GitHub Actions and exits non-zero on any violation

acceptance_checks.then: the site SHALL publish an `/accessibility` page stating the conformance target and the known gaps
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `_site/accessibility/` renders and names WCAG 2.2 AA, the automated axe check, and a contact route for reports

acceptance_checks.when: any page other than the island page is built
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL ship zero bytes of Opal runtime
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script builds the set of every page in `_site` that loads Opal runtime bytes -- resolving each page's `<script src>` references and matching those referenced payloads against `Opal` -- and asserts that set equals exactly {`_site/laboratory/transmutation-circle/index.html`}; the check inspects the referenced `.js` payloads, not the HTML text

acceptance_checks.then: the island page total JavaScript SHALL be at most 150 KiB gzipped
acceptance_checks.verify_method: gzipped byte sum of every script the island page loads is <= 153600

acceptance_checks.when: the drift gate recompiles the source
acceptance_checks.then: the committed output SHALL match a recompile that pins the exact flag set including `--no-source-map`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: CI recompiles with the pinned flag list and byte-compares against the committed artifact; no `sourceMappingURL` appears in the committed output

acceptance_checks.then: the island's Ruby `require` list SHALL be enumerated in a committed manifest with a measured gzipped cost recorded per require
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a committed manifest lists each require with its measured gz delta; every entry beyond `native` carries a measurement predating its adoption

acceptance_checks.when: it is loaded with JavaScript disabled
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL present a static inline SVG of the circle with explanatory prose
acceptance_checks.verify_method: JS-disabled fetch of the island page shows a `<noscript>` region containing an inline `<svg>` and descriptive text

acceptance_checks.then: the island SHALL ship together with a `type: transmutation` post stating, in the owner's own words, what the widget does that justifies 135 KiB of runtime to a reader
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the post contains an explicit value-floor paragraph naming what the widget does for the reader; a reviewer can answer "would someone visit this for its own sake?" from that paragraph alone

acceptance_checks.given: a palette token referenced by a CSS `color`, `border-color`, or `fill` rule that renders body text or a meaning-bearing boundary, and whose manifest role is not `logotype`
acceptance_checks.when: the token classification manifest is applied
acceptance_checks.then: that token SHALL carry manifest role `content` with obligation `ink`, resolving to an `-ink` token rather than an `-ornament` one
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script cross-references every token usage in `_sass/` against the manifest and asserts every non-`logotype` body-text or meaning-bearing-boundary usage resolves to a token whose role is `content` and obligation is `ink`; zero such usages resolve to an `ornament` or `exempt` token

acceptance_checks.then: the repository SHALL carry a committed manifest assigning every palette token exactly one `role` from ornament, logotype, or content together with exactly one `obligation` from ink or exempt, under the mapping in which `content` takes `ink` while `ornament` and `logotype` take `exempt`
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a committed manifest enumerates every token declared in `_sass/_variables.scss` with exactly one role and one obligation each; zero tokens are unclassified; a script asserts that role `content` holds if and only if obligation `ink` for every row, and asserts that every `logotype`-role token is referenced only by rules inside the wordmark selector set (`.hero-subtitle` in `_home.scss` and `_about.scss`) and by no rule that renders body text

acceptance_checks.then: the palette contrast test SHALL run as a blocking continuous-integration check from the first accessibility release onward
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the CI workflow invokes the palette contrast test and exits non-zero on any failing token; the check is present in the same release that ships the ink token split

acceptance_checks.given: the Opal island's transmutation circle animation
acceptance_checks.when: the island page is loaded with no motion preference expressed
acceptance_checks.then: the animation SHALL complete within five seconds rather than loop indefinitely
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a headless run of the island page records zero transform or style mutation on the circle between t=5s and t=15s with no user input; additionally `grep -n "infinite"` over the island's compiled artifact and stylesheet returns zero hits -- the behavioural clause governs, so a `requestAnimationFrame` loop that declares no duration still fails

acceptance_checks.when: a keyboard user tabs to it and operates it with arrow keys
acceptance_checks.then: every interactive control SHALL be keyboard-operable -- reachable, showing a visible focus indicator, and releasing focus on Tab
acceptance_checks.verify_method: keyboard walk of the island page reaches each control, shows a visible focus ring, and exits the widget by Tab without a focus trap

acceptance_checks.when: the site is built
acceptance_checks.then: the island's compiled script SHALL be loaded only by the island page and only with the `defer` attribute
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the island page's script tag matches `defer`; `grep -rl "transmutation-circle" _site --include='*.html'` returns exactly the island page

acceptance_checks.then: the owner's value-floor decision SHALL exist as a committed record stating a `go` verdict before any island source is written
acceptance_checks.verify_method: given island source exists in `_opal/`, a committed decision record states a dated `go` verdict on the value floor and its commit timestamp precedes the first commit touching `_opal/`; a `no-go` record followed by any `_opal/` commit fails

acceptance_checks.when: it is scanned for Font Awesome stylesheet references
acceptance_checks.then: exactly one Font Awesome version SHALL be loaded
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rho "font-awesome[^\"']*" _site | sort -u` yields exactly one version string

acceptance_checks.given: the post front matter across the corpus
acceptance_checks.when: it is scanned for comment-system fields
acceptance_checks.then: no post SHALL declare a `comments` field while no comment system is wired
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rn "^comments:" _posts/` returns zero matches

acceptance_checks.when: the site declares no Portuguese content
acceptance_checks.then: no `og:locale:alternate` value of `pt_BR` SHALL be emitted
acceptance_checks.verify_method: `grep -rn "pt_BR" _site` returns zero matches

acceptance_checks.when: the built site is scanned
acceptance_checks.then: every programming language advertised in the keywords SHALL be a member of the language set backed by the skills data
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script builds the backed set L from `_data/skills.yml` categories["Programming Languages"].skills[].name (case-folded); splits every emitted `<meta name="keywords">` content on commas into case-folded, trimmed tokens K; and for each token matching the pinned language lexicon V = {ruby, elixir, javascript, typescript, golang, go, crystal, python, rust, clojure, java, c, c++, c#, php, perl, scala, kotlin, swift, haskell, erlang} as a whole word, asserts that language is a member of L; zero unbacked languages remain (today's unbacked set is golang, crystal, python, rust)

acceptance_checks.given: a fluid type rule expressed with `clamp()`
acceptance_checks.when: its middle term is inspected
acceptance_checks.then: that middle term SHALL carry a `rem` or `px` component rather than a viewport unit alone
acceptance_checks.verify_method: a script parses every `clamp()` in `_sass/` and asserts each middle term matches a `rem` or `px` component; zero `vw`-only middle terms remain

acceptance_checks.then: the `type: transmutation` post SHALL state the shipped island artifact's re-measured gzipped size together with its runtime/require/app-code tier decomposition
acceptance_checks.verify_method: the post states the shipped artifact's final measured gzipped bytes, equal to the artifact's own component of the CI measurement AC-042 performs on the island page (the artifact figure, not the page total -- the two differ by the page's other scripts), states the three tier percentages (runtime / require / app code) summing to 100, names the per-file-sum method for the site-JS baseline (each file gzipped separately, as served), and `grep -nE "7,?862|7\.9 ?KB|17\.8|18\.25" <post>` returns zero matches
